results.title: The chapter header's actions
results.checks: At the top right of the chapter, in the old reader's order: ☆ Save chapter fills when tapped, Bookmark, Discover opens the Discover pane, Share opens the Share dialog with the chapter's link, and the orange Listen plays the recording and turns into Pause
results.note: header: Save chapter · Bookmark this chapter · Discover · Share · Listen; Save filled and cleared; Discover opened its pane; Share opened the dialog; Listen played and paused

results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in

results.title: Tab marks and the collapsed rail
results.checks: A bookmark on John 3 puts its ribbon on the tab's row, and Listen puts a speaker there while it plays. With the sidebar closed to its rail, the tab is the old reader's tile: 'JHN 3', the speaker, and a label that says it is playing audio
results.note: row: ribbon and speaker; rail tile 'JHN 3', 'JHN 3 — playing audio'; the speaker went with Pause

results.title: The embed's own controls
results.checks: John 3 embedded (?embed=minimal) has only Open in New Tab and Text settings in its header, and the ‹ John 3 › bar along the bottom: › goes to John 4. Open in New Tab opens John 4 in Seed Bible itself, without the embed. A verse offers Copy, Compare, Share and Cancel — no Highlight, Save or Note. Text settings opens the Theme & text sheet without 'Go to all settings'
results.note: header: Open in New Tab · Text settings; the bar went to John 4; Open in New Tab opened /read/BSB/JHN/4; verse: Copy · Compare · Share · Cancel; the sheet without Go to all settings

results.title: Listening follows the verse; the ring when paused
results.checks: Listening to John 3, a jump near the end of the bar brings the verse being read into view on its own; on an iPhone 13, pausing part-way puts a progress ring round the play button, and the scrubber shows again on Play
results.note: a jump to 85% brought verse 31 into view; on a phone the ring showed when paused and the scrubber on Play
